CausalStep.title: CausalStep
CausalStep.description: One link in the fixed cyber-physical causal chain for a run (diagnostics/causal.py).

ContextPacketSummary.title: ContextPacketSummary
ContextPacketSummary.description: What an agent was shown (PRD §10.8) — stored for audit; the full text is not persisted.

EdgeOrigin.title: EdgeOrigin
EdgeOrigin.description: Where an edge came from. FR-03: call graph, declared wiring and inferred dependency must differ.

Epistemic.title: Epistemic
Epistemic.description: What kind of knowledge a piece of evidence is (PRD §9.3).

ExecuteActionRequest.title: ExecuteActionRequest
ExecuteActionRequest.description:
`source` overrides the observation source for repeat/verify runs. `approve_once` is the engineer
individually approving one tool call whose category is not granted (never available to agents).

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description: The three distinct facts PRD §5.3 says must never be conflated.

FlowEvent.title: FlowEvent
FlowEvent.description:
One item on the persisted chronological Event flow. Derived deterministically from
persisted records (D-024); ids stay stable across reloads.

FlowLane.title: FlowLane
FlowLane.description:
Chronological lanes for one test run. Lanes describe *what kind of record* an event is,
not a fictional execution DAG (D-024).

ObservationSourceSpec-Input.title: ObservationSourceSpec
ObservationSourceSpec-Input.description: replay = recorded/synthetic file; sim = simulated rig through the live pipeline; live = real devices.

ObservationSourceSpec-Output.title: ObservationSourceSpec
ObservationSourceSpec-Output.description: replay = recorded/synthetic file; sim = simulated rig through the live pipeline; live = real devices.

ProviderStatus.title: ProviderStatus
ProviderStatus.description:
Per-stage provider attribution (D-023): orchestration may come from a different
provider than the specialists.

RepairPreflight.title: RepairPreflight
RepairPreflight.description: What `POST .../repairs` would need to succeed — precise missing prerequisites, not guessing.

RepairResult.title: RepairResult
RepairResult.description: Remote result, reviewable. Never treated as a hardware fix (D-025).

RepairState.title: RepairState
RepairState.description:
Local lifecycle mapped from Devin session states. `uncertain` = create timed out; the
session may exist remotely but we cannot know without a session id.

RepoSnapshot.title: RepoSnapshot
RepoSnapshot.description: What the repair was based on (D-025). `dirty_files` are NOT included in the remote session.

ToolCall.title: ToolCall
ToolCall.description: Audit record for every tool invocation, grant decision and denial (PRD §13.3).

Verification.title: Verification
Verification.description: Confidence category for graph nodes/edges (PRD FR-03).
